fichas.title: Stationary Circus
fichas.summary: Permanent circus theatre in Berlin Leipziger Platz, with an amphitheatre-type hall laid out as three quarters of a circle for 1,600 audience members. The remaining quarter is for a stage made of five stacked lifting platforms, enabling rapid changes of stage sets. The circus arena is spanned by a reinforced-concrete dome.

enables the stage sets to be changed very quickly ~

e.
